mapper.select: UPDATE candidate_job_match_analyses SET status = 'PROCESSING', attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, deadline_at = #{deadline}, trace_id = #{traceId}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{analysisId} AND candidate_profile_id IS NOT NULL AND attempt_count < #{maxAttempts} AND ( status = 'PENDING' OR ( status = 'PROCESSING' AND (deadline_at IS NULL OR deadline_at <= #{now}) ) ) RETURNING id AS analysis_id, application_id, candidate_profile_id, job_snapshot::TEXT, attempt_count
mapper.update: UPDATE candidate_job_match_analyses SET status = 'COMPLETED', match_score = #{matchScore}, pass_probability = #{passProbability}, strengths_json = CAST(#{strengthsJson} AS JSONB), gaps_json = CAST(#{gapsJson} AS JSONB), llm_config_snapshot = CAST(#{snapshotJson} AS JSONB), deadline_at = NULL, failure_reason = NULL, analyzed_at = #{now}, trace_id = #{traceId}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{analysisId} AND attempt_count = #{attemptCount} AND status = 'PROCESSING'

UPDATE candidate_job_match_analyses SET status = 'FAILED', deadline_at = NULL, failure_reason = #{failureReason}, trace_id = #{traceId}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{analysisId} AND status = 'WAITING_PROFILE'
